title: TNT Tools Mod
description: A mod which adds TNT tools to Minecraft
body:
Adds more tools for Minecraft (which the textures are missimg)
tools:
TNT pickaxe
TNT axe
TNT shovel
TNT hoe
TNT sword

the all explode when right ckick on a block, when it hits an entity or when you bracke a block

and adds a new entity called dummy which is used to traine your PVP skills with the new tools
